summary: Compute the explicit two-branch weights and retain the separate alpha=1 Maxwellian convention.

identity.definition: For alpha!=1: ra=(1-alpha*Delta)/(1-alpha), rb=alpha*(Delta-1)/(1-alpha), ra+rb=1. For alpha==1 return(1,0) independently of Delta. Second branch perpendicular thermal-speed squared is alpha times the first branch in equilibrium assembly.
identity.model: Explicit rational approximation or two-Gaussian representation for magnetized kinetic response.
identity.geometry: Cartesian k=(kx,0,kz), B0 along signed z; non-spatial representation for pole/partition operators.
identity.coordinates: SI angular frequency rad/s and wave number m^-1; normalized source scan/selection quantities are labeled explicitly.
identity.boundary: Uniform/local plane-wave response; no spatial boundary-value problem or nonlinear saturation.
assumptions: Caller retains the explicit truncation, state provenance and normalization.

inputs.name: alphas
inputs.constraints: Finite alpha>0; same shape as Deltas; alpha==1 is a separately defined Maxwellian bypass.

inputs.name: Deltas
inputs.constraints: Finite0<=Delta<=1; alpha==1 bypass does not claim continuity for arbitrary Delta.

outputs.name: rsab
outputs.description: Core and loss-cone Gaussian weights, flattened species order.
outputs.constraints: Accessible in returned NativeResult.state; scientific meaning applies only to a compatible completed predecessor. Empty inactive arrays are preserved.

preconditions: Positive finite alpha and Delta in[0,1], identical input shapes.
supported: Positive finite alpha and Delta in[0,1], identical input shapes.
excluded: Global nonlinear plasma evolution and a guarantee of unique physical mode identification.
